# CodeAtlas Corporate Contributor License Agreement

**Version 1.0 — 2026-10-03**

This agreement is for a **company** whose employees contribute to CodeAtlas. It
is adapted from the Apache Software Foundation Corporate CLA v2.0.

## When you need this

Use the Corporate CLA when any of the following is true:

- Employees contribute to CodeAtlas as part of their job.
- Your employment agreements assign employee-created IP to the company.
- Contributions are made using company time, equipment, or confidential
  information.

If you are contributing purely on your own behalf, outside work, with no
employer claim on the output, use the [Individual CLA](CLA.md) instead.

Many employment contracts claim ownership of code employees write even outside
working hours. A developer who signs only the Individual CLA in that situation
may be granting rights they do not hold — which leaves both them and this
project exposed. The Corporate CLA exists to resolve that cleanly.

## Definitions

**"Corporation"** means the legal entity executing this agreement, together
with entities that control, are controlled by, or are under common control with
it.

**"Project Owner"** means Vamsi Krishna Kanneganti (GitHub: `vamsikk7`), the copyright holder of CodeAtlas.

**"Contribution"** means any original work of authorship — including
modifications and additions to existing work — intentionally submitted to the
Project Owner for inclusion in CodeAtlas by the Corporation or by an employee
authorised under this agreement.

## 1. Copyright licence

The Corporation grants the Project Owner, and to recipients of software
distributed by the Project Owner, a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive,
no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable copyright licence to reproduce, prepare
derivative works of, publicly display, publicly perform, sublicense, and
distribute Contributions and such derivative works.

## 2. Patent licence

The Corporation grants the Project Owner, and to recipients of software
distributed by the Project Owner, a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive,
no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable (except as stated below) patent licence to
make, have made, use, offer to sell, sell, import, and otherwise transfer
Contributions.

This licence applies only to patent claims licensable by the Corporation that
are necessarily infringed by a Contribution alone, or by the combination of a
Contribution with the work to which it was submitted.

If any entity institutes patent litigation alleging that a Contribution, or the
work it was submitted to, constitutes direct or contributory patent
infringement, then any patent licences granted to that entity under this
agreement terminate as of the date such litigation is filed.

## 3. Relicensing

The Corporation grants the Project Owner the right to license Contributions
under terms of the Project Owner's choosing, **including proprietary or
commercial terms**, in addition to the Apache License 2.0.

A Contribution may therefore appear in a commercially licensed CodeAtlas
product with no payment or separate consent. Code already released under
Apache-2.0 remains available under Apache-2.0 permanently; relicensing adds a
licence rather than withdrawing the open one.

Please route this clause past whoever reviews outbound IP licences at your
company before signing. It is the clause they will care about.

## 4. Representations

The Corporation represents that:

1. It is legally entitled to grant the above licences.
2. Each Contribution is an original creation of the Corporation or its
   authorised employees, or the Corporation holds the necessary rights.
3. It will notify the Project Owner of any fact that makes these
   representations inaccurate.
4. Third-party material in any Contribution is identified as such, with its
   source and licence.

## 5. Authorised contributors

The Corporation maintains the list of employees authorised to contribute under
this agreement, in Schedule A below. The list may be updated by notifying the
Project Owner in writing.

Contributions from a person not on the list are not covered by this agreement
and will be treated under the Individual CLA.

The Corporation is responsible for keeping the list current. Employees who
leave should be removed.

## 6. No warranty and no obligation

Contributions are provided "AS IS", without warranties or conditions of any
kind, except for the representations in section 4. The Project Owner is under
no obligation to accept, merge, or keep any Contribution.

## How to execute

1. Fill in Schedule A.
2. Email the completed agreement to `vamsi.iiita@gmail.com` from a company
   email address, signed by someone authorised to bind the Corporation.
3. Listed employees then sign the CLA Assistant prompt on their first pull
   request; their signature is matched against this agreement.
